label: Advaita Vedanta metaphysics and the concept of the illusory phenomenal world as Maya directly influenced Schopenhauer's World as Will and Representation
description: Arthur Schopenhauer was fundamentally influenced by Adi Shankara's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Adi Shankara's perspective to Arthur Schopenhauer's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Eastern & Axial Traditions across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
